role_in_op: Main objective (platoon) of op 3 and the next FOB. The CIS boatyard town at the head of the Sound: crews and spares for the west-rim boats, the slips 450 m east-south-east (3-05), the fuel depot 670 m south-west (3-13). The garrison holds the quay front, the square under the control spire and the two upper lanes that look down the inlet.
approaches_text: From the sea: up the Sound once the gate is blown (op 3 final), or by LAAT; the quay is the town's front door. From the road: the Notch road from the south-west past the fuel depot. From the hill: the path down from the Summit AA (north-west) and the farm lane from the west.
